decision.analysis: Market Analysis (2026-03-06, Market Open Session): The market shows mixed signals with strong earnings growth (S&P 500 tracking double-digit growth) but significant uncertainty from tariff litigation and geopolitical tensions. This approach aligns with value investing principles: hold quality companies through volatility and preserve capital for compelling opportunities.
